findings.title: Button float:right inside new flex container no longer works
findings.body: .small-action is now a flex container (@include flexbox()), but its child button still relies on `float: right` to be pushed to the right edge. Floats are ignored on flex items, so the button will now sit immediately after .small-action-desc instead of at the far right of the row. The same applies to `float: left` on .topic-avatar and .small-action-desc .avatar (avatar is not a flex item so that one still works, but the button and topic-avatar are direct flex items). The button rule needs `margin-left: auto` (as was done for .panel in header.scss) or the container needs justify-content to preserve the previous layout.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits invalid -ms-align-items property and values incompatible with old box syntax
findings.body: The align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a real vendor-prefixed property in any browser, so it is dead output. More importantly, when called with `baseline` (badges.css.scss for .badge-wrapper.bullet), it emits `-webkit-box-align: baseline` and `-ms-flex-align: baseline`; the 2009 box syntax and IE10's -ms-flex-align only accept start/end/center/stretch, so those declarations are dropped. Browsers needing the prefixed fallbacks (old Safari, IE10) will get no alignment at all for the baseline case, changing badge rendering versus the previous unprefixed-only code path only in modern browsers is fine, but the mixin gives a false sense of compatibility.

findings.title: Dead float rules remain on flex items in header
findings.body: After making .d-header .contents a flex container, several children that are now flex items still carry float rules: .icons (float: left), .icons > li (float: left is on a non-flex child so still effective), and .login-button/.sign-up-button (float: left). Floats on direct flex items are ignored, so .icons and the login/sign-up buttons no longer float; they rely on flex source order plus .panel's margin-left:auto/order(3). Any markup where these elements are not in the expected DOM order, or any CSS that expected the float behavior (e.g., text wrapping around the floated icons list), will render differently. The stale float declarations should be removed or the layout verified for all header states (logged-in, anon with login/signup buttons, docked).
